script:
intro E _ δ s x
ext z
constructor

  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_mul.1 hz

  · calc dist (x⁻¹ * (a * b)) b
        = dist (x⁻¹ * (a * b)) (x⁻¹ * (x * b)) := by rw [inv_mul_cancel_left]

name: Ordinal.log_opow_mul_add
script:
intro b u v w hb hv hw
have hb0 : (0 : Ordinal) < b := lt_trans zero_lt_one hb
have hbu : (0 : Ordinal) < b ^ u := Ordinal.opow_pos u hb0
have hx : b ^ u * v + w ≠ 0 := by
  have h1 : 0 < b ^ u * v := Ordinal.mul_pos hbu (Ordinal.pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hv)
  exact ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le h1 (Ordinal.le_add_right _ _))
apply le_antisymm
· rw [← Order.lt_succ_iff, ← Ordinal.lt_opow_iff_log_lt hb hx]
  calc b ^ u * v + w < b ^ u * v + b ^ u := (Ordinal.add_lt_add_iff_left _).mpr hw
    _ = b ^ u * (v + 1) := by rw [mul_add, mul_one]
    _ ≤ b ^ u * b ^ Order.succ (Ordinal.log b v) := by
        refine Ordinal.mul_le_mul_left' ?_ _
        rw [Ordinal.add_one_eq_succ, Order.succ_le_iff]
        exact Ordinal.lt_opow_succ_log_self hb v
    _ = b ^ (u + Order.succ (Ordinal.log b v)) := (Ordinal.opow_add b u _).symm
    _ = b ^ Order.succ (u + Ordinal.log b v) := by rw [Ordinal.add_succ]
· rw [← Ordinal.opow_le_iff_le_log hb hx, Ordinal.opow_add]
  calc b ^ u * b ^ Ordinal.log b v ≤ b ^ u * v :=
        Ordinal.mul_le_mul_left' (Ordinal.opow_log_le_self b hv) _
    _ ≤ b ^ u * v + w := Ordinal.le_add_right _ _

have key : Prod.snd '' ((fun p : ↥s × G => p.2 - (p.1 : G)) ⁻¹' t) = t + s := by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm

name: List.intercalate_splitOn
script:
intro α xs x inst
have h2 : ∀ (a : List α) (L : List (List α)),
    [x].intercalate ([] :: a :: L) = x :: [x].intercalate (a :: L) := by
  intro a L
  simp [List.intercalate, List.intersperse]
have h1 : ∀ (hd : α) (a : List α) (L : List (List α)),
    [x].intercalate ((hd :: a) :: L) = hd :: [x].intercalate (a :: L) := by
  intro hd a L
  cases L with
  | nil => simp [List.intercalate, List.intersperse]
  | cons b L' => simp [List.intercalate, List.intersperse]
have key : ∀ l : List α, ∃ a L, List.splitOnP (fun b => b == x) l = a :: L ∧
    [x].intercalate (a :: L) = l := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    refine ⟨[], [], ?_, ?_⟩
    · first
      | rfl
      | simp
      | simp [List.splitOnP, List.splitOnP.go]
    · simp [List.intercalate, List.intersperse]
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    obtain ⟨a, L, e1, e2⟩ := ih
    by_cases h : hd = x
    · refine ⟨[], a :: L, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [List.splitOnP_cons, e1]
        simp [h]
      · rw [h2, e2, h]
    · refine ⟨hd :: a, L, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [List.splitOnP_cons, e1]
        simp [h]
      · rw [h1, e2]
obtain ⟨a, L, e1, e2⟩ := key xs
have e3 : List.splitOn x xs = a :: L := by
  first
  | exact e1
  | (unfold List.splitOn; exact e1)
  | simpa [List.splitOn] using e1
rw [e3]
exact e2
